lithology_description: Dolomitic marbles calc-silicate rocks and actinolite-tremolite schists
manganese_ore_association: Subordinate/Minor manganese oxide lenses in calc-granulite
notes: Topmost formation of the Sausar Group sequence in Balaghat district.

lithology_description: Tabloid biotite-muscovite schists and quartz-biotite granulites
manganese_ore_association: Barren to sparse manganese silicate disseminations
notes: Intermediate pelitic-psammitic sequence between Bichua and Chorbaoli.

lithology_description: Quartzites quartz-muscovite schists and sillimanite quartz schists
manganese_ore_association: Minor gondite lenses at stratigraphic contact with Mansar
notes: Resistant quartzite ridges forming prominent topographic relief in Balaghat.

lithology_description: Mica schists phyllites gondites and bedded manganese oxide reefs
manganese_ore_association: Major primary manganese ore horizon (Braunite-Pyrolusite reef)
primary_minerals: Braunite Pyrolusite Psilomelane Spessartine Rhodonite Quartz Muscovite
notes: Primary economic manganese ore-bearing formation in Central India Manganese Belt. Deeply folded reef structure.

lithology_description: Pink calcitic marbles and banded calc-granulites (Utekata facies)
manganese_ore_association: Bedded braunite and hollandite ore bands in calc-silicates
notes: Carbonate-rich unit hosting stratiform manganese oxide lenses.

manganese_ore_association: Minor bedded manganese ore at base of Mansar contact
notes: Basal psammitic unit of the Sausar Group resting on Tirodi Gneiss.

lithology_description: Coarse foliated biotite gneiss amphibolite and porphyroblastic granite gneiss
manganese_ore_association: Manganese ore enclaves and gondite synforms caught in basement
primary_minerals: Biotite Oligoclase Quartz Microcline Hornblende Braunite
notes: Basement granitic-gneissic complex forming the floor of the Sausar sedimentary basin.
